description.Name: MOFOMIC-NIMF1

latestSnapshot.readme:
The NIMF1 dataset is part of the Moral Foundations MRI Collection (MOFOMIC), a collection of multimodal (3T) MRI datasets including structural (T1-weighted), and (task-based) functional BOLD MRI data, as well as detailed demographics and psychometric variables from healthy participants.

This dataset contains both raw and preprocessed data (and other "derivatives"), which is available on [Openneuro](https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds007391).

The contents of this dataset are described in detail in [this preprint](https://www.psycharchives.org/en/item/c727daa5-d237-4162-8a93-f2e19ef75f98). More general information about the MOFOMIC datasets, including instructions on how to download (parts of) it, check out the [MOFOMIC website](https://www.medianeuroscience.org/mofomic/).

For this dataset, please consider the following known caveats: 
- Onset times in the _event.tsv files were adjusted for the 11 dummy scans at the beginning and do not need further modification.
- Functional BOLD files (both raw and preprocessed) still contain the 11 dummy volumes at the beginning and end of each run and should be removed before modelling
- Subject-35: Misses the last (3rd) run of the vignettes
- Subject-49: During the first run of the vignettes, the scanner keyboard always collected a rating of 2, so these ratings were imputed as "missing"
